tools.name: handover.whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated person or service agent, organization, workspace, role, and granted scopes. Call this before reading or publishing to confirm attribution and tenancy.

tools.name: handover.search
tools.description: Find current shared context with hybrid, semantic, or lexical retrieval across metadata and artifact content. Use an empty query to list recent handovers.

tools.name: handover.get
tools.description: Read a handover snapshot, continuation brief, artifact metadata, and revision history. Omit revisionId for the current snapshot.

handoverId.description: Handover identifier returned by handover.search or handover.create.

revisionId.description: Optional immutable revision; omit to inspect the current revision.

tools.name: handover.read_artifact
tools.description: Read bounded artifact content after inspecting a handover. Text is returned as UTF-8 and binary content as base64; truncated results report that explicitly.

maxBytes.description: Maximum decoded bytes to return before reporting truncation.

tools.name: handover.thread
tools.description: Read comments, explicit mentions, assignments, and eligible collaborators without changing revision history.

handoverId.description: Handover whose discussion and assignments should be read.

tools.name: handover.annotations
tools.description: Read revision-anchored file comments, selected text, status, authorship, and resolution metadata. Use status=open to find feedback that still needs action.

handoverId.description: Handover whose annotation threads should be read.

tools.name: handover.create
tools.description: Create durable shared context with an initial immutable revision. Authorship comes from the authenticated Handover identity.

title.description: Short, specific name for the durable context.

summary.description: Concise explanation of what this handover contains.

note.description: Free-form continuation note recorded in the initial revision.

objective.description: The outcome the next human or agent should continue toward.

currentState.description: Verified state at the moment this revision is published.

decisions.description: Decisions already made that successors should preserve.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions that still require evidence or judgment.

nextSteps.description: Concrete continuation steps for the receiving actor.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this step.

status.description: Whether the step still needs action.

brief.description: Structured continuation brief for humans and agents.

artifacts.description: Files attached to the initial immutable revision.

mediaType.description: IANA media type, such as text/markdown or text/x-sql.

content.description: UTF-8 text, or base64 when encoding is base64.

tools.name: handover.continue
tools.description: Append an immutable revision after reading the current snapshot. expectedRevisionId is mandatory to prevent overwriting another collaborator's work. Omitted artifacts are inherited; matching names are replaced.

handoverId.description: Handover to continue after reading its current snapshot.

expectedRevisionId.description: Current revision ID returned by handover.get; prevents lost updates.

note.description: What changed or what the next collaborator should know.

objective.description: The outcome the next human or agent should continue toward.

currentState.description: Verified state at the moment this revision is published.

decisions.description: Decisions already made that successors should preserve.

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions that still require evidence or judgment.

nextSteps.description: Concrete continuation steps for the receiving actor.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this step.

status.description: Whether the step still needs action.

artifacts.description: New or replacement files; omitted files remain inherited.

mediaType.description: IANA media type, such as text/markdown or text/x-sql.

content.description: UTF-8 text, or base64 when encoding is base64.

tools.name: handover.comment
tools.description: Append a discussion comment and optionally notify explicitly mentioned collaborators.

handoverId.description: Handover discussion to append the comment to.

body.description: Comment body in plain text or Markdown.

mentionPrincipalIds.description: Collaborator principal IDs to mention and notify.

tools.name: handover.annotate
tools.description: Add a durable comment anchored to selected text or lines in an immutable artifact revision. Read the artifact first and preserve the exact quote and surrounding context.

handoverId.description: Handover containing the artifact being annotated.

body.description: Actionable annotation body in plain text or Markdown.

revisionId.description: Immutable revision containing the annotated artifact.

artifactId.description: Artifact containing the selected text or code.

targetKind.description: Rendering context used to relocate and display the annotation.

startOffset.description: Zero-based character offset where the selection starts.

endOffset.description: Zero-based character offset immediately after the selection.

startLine.description: Zero-based line where the selection starts.

endLine.description: Zero-based line where the selection ends.

selector.description: Exact quote plus optional position and surrounding context.

target.description: Immutable artifact location to anchor this annotation.

mentionPrincipalIds.description: Collaborator principal IDs to mention and notify.

tools.name: handover.update_comment
tools.description: Edit an authored comment, or resolve/reopen an annotation. Set resolvedRevisionId when a new handover revision addressed the feedback.

commentId.description: Comment or annotation to edit, resolve, or reopen.

body.description: Replacement comment body; omit to preserve the current body.

revisionId.description: Immutable revision containing the annotated artifact.

artifactId.description: Artifact containing the selected text or code.

targetKind.description: Rendering context used to relocate and display the annotation.

startOffset.description: Zero-based character offset where the selection starts.

endOffset.description: Zero-based character offset immediately after the selection.

startLine.description: Zero-based line where the selection starts.

endLine.description: Zero-based line where the selection ends.

selector.description: Exact quote plus optional position and surrounding context.

target.description: Replacement annotation target, or null to remove the anchor.

status.description: Open, resolve, or reopen the feedback thread.

resolvedRevisionId.description: Revision that addressed the feedback, or null when reopening.

tools.name: handover.assign
tools.description: Replace the open assignments with the supplied collaborator identities. This changes collaboration state, not the immutable handover revision.

handoverId.description: Handover whose open assignments will be replaced.

principalIds.description: Complete replacement list of assigned collaborator principal IDs.

tools.name: handover.publish
tools.description: Create or update a stable /r/{slug}/ report projection of a Handover revision.

handoverId.description: Handover to project as a stable report.

slug.description: Stable URL slug; generated from the title when omitted.

entryPath.description: Artifact path opened first when readers visit the report.

access.description: Who can open the report URL.

revisionMode.description: Follow new revisions automatically or keep one revision pinned.

revisionId.description: Revision to pin; used when revisionMode is pinned.

tools.name: handover.publication
tools.description: Read the stable report URL, entry file, access mode, and selected revision for a handover.

handoverId.description: Handover whose publication should be inspected.

tools.name: handover.pull
tools.description: Return the selected files of a published report with paths, hashes, media types, and UTF-8 or base64 content.

files.description: Optional relative paths to return; omit for every file.

includeBinary.description: Return binary files as base64 when true.

tools.name: handover.okf.export
tools.description: Export a handover revision as an Open Knowledge Format bundle for another human or agent system.

revisionId.description: Immutable revision to export; defaults to the current revision.

tools.name: handover.okf.import
tools.description: Import Open Knowledge Format files into a new immutable Handover revision. Replaying the same bundle is idempotent.

handoverId.description: Existing handover that will receive the imported bundle.

expectedRevisionId.description: Current revision ID used to prevent conflicting imports.

mode.description: Merge bundle files with inherited artifacts or replace them.

files.description: Files from an Open Knowledge Format bundle.

path.description: Relative path of this file inside the OKF bundle.

mediaType.description: IANA media type; inferred from path when omitted.

encoding.description: How content is encoded in this request.

content.description: UTF-8 text, or base64 when encoding is base64.
